description: Volume play targeting founders, coaches, creators, and ecommerce brand owners who are actively creating video content. Core FASTECH ICP. Deeply personalized emails via Firecrawl.

instagram_search.note: Run the hashtag terms through the SAME Instagram user search C2 already uses (no separate hashtag scraper). One term per call. Single-word terms have returned a validation error before (2026-10-02) - if a term errors, retry once with its spaced fallback, then skip it.

hashtag_lead_filters.must_have: email in bio OR an external URL in the profile
hashtag_lead_filters.email_rule: Personal email only (firstname@domain, name.surname@domain, or a personal Gmail/Outlook). Role inboxes (info@, hello@, contact@, support@, team@, admin@, sales@, marketing@ ...) = RED, not YELLOW - no manual-approval queue for C2.

filters.exclude_eu_rule: Skip any lead located in an EU member state (Austria, Belgium, Bulgaria, Croatia, Cyprus, Czechia, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Ireland, Italy, Latvia, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Malta, Netherlands, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden). The UK is NOT in the EU - UK leads are kept. Notes: 'EU - excluded'.

target_decision_maker.note: The account owner IS the decision maker. Direct outreach only.

email_angle: Hyper-personalized. Reference something specific from their website or recent content. Connect their content creation to FASTECH's ability to produce more, faster, better — so they can focus on strategy and showing up, not editing.
subject_line_examples: what I noticed about your [niche] content
helping [niche] founders scale their video output

extract_fields: any social proof or client results they mention
pain points visible (small team, lots of content, etc.)
